system.description: When a Creatures currently under the effects of a jutsu you cast would make a saving throw to resist its effects, you impart a lasting weight on them regardless of their results. Spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, they must reroll the saving throw, taking the lower result. On a failed save, they gain 1 rank of Demoralized, Shaken or Sealed, your choice.
